stem: A long-term retention requirement applies only to EBS volume history, with no other AWS resource type needing the same policy, and the team wants the lowest storage cost for snapshots kept well past 90 days.

choices.text: Create an AWS Backup plan across all resource types with a cold storage lifecycle
Move the EBS snapshots to the EBS Snapshot Archive tier
Copy the EBS snapshots into S3 Glacier Deep Archive
Enable AWS Backup Vault Lock on the vault holding the snapshots

rationale: The EBS Snapshot Archive tier is built for exactly this case: EBS-only, long-term retention without needing a cross-service policy engine, offering up to about 75% lower storage cost for snapshots kept 90 days or longer. Building an AWS Backup plan across every resource type adds a cross-service policy engine the requirement does not call for, since only EBS volume history needs the policy. Copying snapshots into S3 Glacier Deep Archive treats snapshot data as if it were object data, which is not how EBS snapshots are stored or archived. Vault Lock makes a backup vault's retention settings immutable for compliance; it does not lower the storage cost of keeping the snapshots.
